searchText: If we ban `ORIGIN` can we also ban `GASPRICE`? I think `GASPRICE` is actually useful for paying transaction sponsors? There is no `GAS` in EOF 🙂 i think gasprice is useful to inspect you can send value based on gasprice for instance But you have to guess the gas used to make sense of it. Unless we can count on contract authors to always take the multipler from external data I am a bit concerned GASPRICE could wedge some contracts again if dramatic gas schedules change. I would support removing it but won't push.
